catalog.summary: Full-screen viewer of files: fitted, zoomed, stepped.

patternStatus: No APG pattern names a viewer. The dialog pattern answers the layer: focus enters it, Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger; the dialog family this one composes answers each item. Initial focus is the stage, after the pattern's first note: the content is a picture, not a control. Read on 2026-10-30.

nativeElement.reason: The layer is dialog's; inside it every medium is the platform's own element — img, an iframe for the browser's PDF and text reader, video and audio with the platform's controls.

composedFamilies.dialog: the layer, the scrim, presence, portal, focus containment and restoration, Escape, back and the single z-index stack, with fullScreen always and surface plain. Nothing of the layer is redrawn.
composedFamilies.icon: every glyph the family draws: close, chevrons, zoom, fit, rotate, download and the kind of an unsupported file.

dialog.fullscreenToggle: passed through to dialog, whose fullscreen state model answers it; the viewer holds no second one

items.type: a MIME type, as File.type and attachment's file.type
items.removed: a value no longer in items moves to the next item, or to the previous when it was the last, with the reason remove; an empty set asks to close with programmatic

sandboxReason: No frame runs a file the application did not write: text is drawn by the family as text. The PDF frame carries no sandbox, measured by upload: Chrome's reader refuses a sandboxed frame, and a document served as application/pdf runs no script.

view.fit: the scale at which the whole picture stands inside the stage, never above the picture's own size; level 1 is the fit, drawn by the stylesheet alone
view.center: the stage is a flex scroll container and the picture has margin auto: centerd while it fits, every edge reachable once it does not
view.zoomAround: a step keeps the point under the pointer still, or the stage's center for a button or a key, by moving the stage's scroll

wheel.plain: a wheel without a modifier adds zoomStep for every pixelsPerStep of deltaY
wheel.pinch: with ctrlKey, the trackpad's pinch, the level is multiplied by 2 to the power of -deltaY / pixelsPerStep

view.pan: the stage's own scroll: a finger, a mouse drag, the arrows while zoomed
view.doubleClick: toggles between the fit and twice the fit, around the point
view.swipe: a horizontal touch swipe steps while the level is the fit; zoomed, the finger pans
view.pullDown: a touch drag down from the fit beyond a quarter of the stage closes, with the reason pointer
view.ground: a click on the stage outside the medium closes with outsidePress, unless the pointer moved further than the click slop or a pinch took place
view.reset: a step to another item puts the level back to 1 and the rotation to 0, with the reason select
view.error: an image that failed to load shows the status with the download, and no zoom pill: there is nothing to zoom

scheme.ground: --slotted-media-viewer-ground, the same in light and dark
scheme.rule: the root writes data-slotted-scheme dark, unless the scheme nearest the trigger is high-contrast, which is kept

keyboard.effect: the next control inside the viewer, wrapping
pan the stage by a tenth of its size
zoomStep up, around the stage's center; = does the same

keyboardScope: the keys of the family act on the viewer unless focus is in a video, an audio, an iframe or an editable field, whose own keys win

direction.rtl: ArrowLeft steps to the next item and ArrowRight to the previous; previous sits at the inline start and its chevron mirrors

announce: a step announces the item's name and its position through live-announcer, politely
responsive: previous and next are hidden below 600 pixels of the root's inline size, where the swipe steps
motion: the level and the step move on the motion scale; under reduced motion both snap, and the layer follows dialog

declined.slideshow: carousel owns autoplay; in a viewer the reader takes the step

dataAttributes.data-kind: image, pdf, text, video, audio or other, on the root and the stage
dataAttributes.data-zoomed: on the root and the stage while the level is above the fit
dataAttributes.data-error: on the stage when the medium failed to load
dataAttributes.data-panning: on the stage while a drag or a finger pans
dataAttributes.data-sized: on the frame while the binding writes its size: zoomed or turned. At the fit the stylesheet sizes the picture alone

parts.heading: the title and the position, one column of the bar
parts.frame: the box the picture occupies at the current level, axes swapped at a quarter turn; the stage scrolls over it
parts.text: the page a text file is set on: the pre and, past the limit, the truncated note
parts.tile: the mark of a file the viewer cannot draw, or did not load, with its extension across its foot
parts.retry: loads the shown file again after it failed

kindsByName: a type that is absent or application/octet-stream is read by the name's extension: .json, .yaml, .csv, .md, .log, source files and their kin are text; application/json, application/xml, the +json and +xml types and the YAML, TOML, SQL and script types are text whatever their top-level type

text.drawn: fetched and set in the monospace face inside a pre; never executed, so an HTML file shows its source and no frame is needed
text.json: indented by two spaces when it parses, as written when it does not
text.limit: the first 1 MiB of characters; past it, the truncated message under the page

fallback: a file the browser cannot draw, and one that did not load, share one anatomy: the tile with the kind's mark and the extension, a heading, one sentence, and the actions — retry (outlined) for a failure, download (solid) for both
